statement: The function returns a result res such that: if m*n = R*C, then len(res) = R, len(res[i]) = C for every i with 0 <= i < R, and res[i][j] = mat[(i*C+j)/n][(i*C+j)%n] for every i,j with 0 <= i < R and 0 <= j < C; if m*n != R*C, then len(res) = m, len(res[i]) = n for every i with 0 <= i < m, and res[i][j] = mat[i][j] for every i,j with 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n.
preconditions: Let m = len(mat). The input satisfies m >= 1 and m <= 100. Let n = len(mat[0]). Then n >= 1 and n <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < m, len(mat[i]) = n; for every i,j with 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, -1000 <= mat[i][j] <= 1000. Let R be the natural-number value of r and C the natural-number value of c; then 1 <= R <= 300 and 1 <= C <= 300.
